hotspot_events.title: Follow-up on Panasonic's Hsinchu Hukou Plant Fire in Taiwan: Approximately 4% of Global Supply of MEGTRON High-End CCL Affected
hotspot_events.heat_reason: About 4% of high-end CCL supply impacted, recovery may take months, directly hitting lead times and costs for high-layer/high-speed boards
hotspot_events.summary: Follow-up on the Nov 4 fire at Panasonic's Hsinchu Hukou plant in Taiwan: 2 missing employees confirmed dead, 5 injured. The plant produces MEGTRON high-end ultra-low-loss copper-clad laminates (M6/M7/M8). TrendForce assessed on Nov 5 that approximately 4% of global high-end CCL supply is affected, with recovery potentially taking several months, and orders may shift to Taiwanese CCL manufacturers.
numbers: ~4% of global high-end CCL supply affected

industry_updates.title: Lenovo launches AI and HPC convergence next-generation infrastructure, Neptune liquid-cooling can remove 100% system heat
industry_updates.detail: Neptune liquid-cooling ThinkSystem SC755 can remove up to 100% of system heat via water, delivering up to 40% higher sustained performance compared to comparable air-cooled systems; targeted at enterprises and gigawatt-scale AI factories.

industry_updates.title: NVIDIA Rubin platform achieves 100% closed-loop liquid cooling, water supply temperature limit raised to 45°C
industry_updates.detail: Rubin is the first 100% closed-loop liquid-cooled AI server architecture, using 75% water + 25% propylene glycol to directly cool chips, eliminating the need for chillers and evaporative water consumption; Microsoft’s next-generation data centers also adopt a closed-loop zero-evaporation design.
